extraction.Name: Frank Bird Necklace
extraction.Cancelled: he has asked the Secretary of the Interior to cancel his patent, but he has not heard anything in regard to the matter
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment, because he did not want to pay the taxes; but he took the patent on being advised to do so by the people at the Indian Agency
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: he has never sold or mortgaged any part of his allotment at all; but he has not paid any taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he has not paid any taxes; hence the taxes on this land are still hanging over it
extraction.Occupation/Income: his income is small—the only source being what he raises in the way of small crops on this allotment
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is poor, being bothered with his heart, this of twenty years standing; has a wife and three children—two children being self-supporting—and he supports wife and minor child; health of his wife is exceedingly poor, having rheumatism and tuberculosis; health of the minor child is good; has never received any aid from the County or Government; document number 279; sworn November 10, 1928; County of Shannon
